metadata.location: meta.p12; data.p12 for detail; data[].p12 for list

sources.WARRANTY: P09 warranty case, never a fabricated stock document

metadata.backwards_compatibility: Original data/status/mini_app_status/readiness/ETag preserved; metadata is additive. No mandatory header.
metadata.status: status.canonical and status.mini_app are distinct owner fields; readiness is not proof of review, sending to Web, approval or posting.
metadata.legacy_inbound: WAITING_APPROVAL remains the existing scan-readiness alias for old clients, not a cross-source state or handoff event.
metadata.all_sources: No merged endpoint, complete total, shared pagination or frozen snapshot is introduced.

stock_list.pagination: OFFSET; no cursor or frozen snapshot

warranty: P09 queries unchanged; date_mode/date_field/date/from/to are the separately implemented P23 extension. Do not send stock date_from/date_to/sort_order or copy its paging cap.

timeline.created: Exact server created_at, with timestamp_source; null stays NOT_RECORDED.
timeline.checked: SOURCE_MAPPING_PENDING; do not infer from SCANNING, counters, state history aliases or doc_date.
timeline.sent_to_web: SOURCE_MAPPING_PENDING; do not repurpose generic submitted_at/approved_at until the owner mapping is approved.
timeline.posted: Exact stock_documents.posted_at only, never inferred from POSTED status. Warranty receipt/case is stock-neutral: NOT_APPLICABLE.
timeline.event_id: null for timestamp-column evidence; no synthetic event IDs.
timeline.coverage: PARTIAL is explicit, not a claim that the event did not happen.

scan_summary.scope: Whole authorized parent/status query before pagination
scan_summary.null_rule: quantity is null when any row in that unit lacks quantity; known_quantity is only the known subtotal, null when none known. No null-to-zero.
scan_summary.quantity_total: Only confirmed empty=0 or one non-empty unit with all quantities known; otherwise null.
scan_summary.rolling_cache: Legacy cached summary is marked LEGACY_CACHE_PENDING_REFRESH with unknown quantities until the existing short read cache refreshes.
scan_summary.children: A failed scan/files request is not an empty parent. Do not use embedded item_matches as a paginated evidence source.

p09_bridge.success: Only SUCCEEDED plus matching canonical warranty_case_id, after existing owner ACL, exposes GET case detail target.
p09_bridge.other_states: UNKNOWN/PROCESSING/FAILED have no target; original receipt and may_create_new_request policy remain owned by P09.
p09_bridge.pii: No receipt note/name/phone is added; existing safeCase and event redaction remain in force.

attachments.fix: INBOUND/OUTBOUND validate existing non-deleted parent of exact canonical type and warehouse before streaming; missing, wrong-type, or soft-deleted parent fails closed even for global users.
attachments.binary: Existing owner stream, MIME handling, private no-store/nosniff and download audit preserved.
attachments.outside_scope: No new route, upload/delete capability, Web attachment controller rewrite, or reversal-owner change.

unchanged: P04 GLOBAL supplier lookup q/status/page/per_page; no warehouse_id
P04 write note 1000; P12 readonly note is not truncated; P05/P09 limits unchanged
P04/P05/P09 command/UNKNOWN owners; no recreate in P12
Old removed repair scripts stay removed

validation.ci_only: Disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL regressions, real test-byte download/ACL errors, route cache, ancestry and locked Composer audit. NOT live evidence.
pending: BA All presentation and cross-source state mapping
Approved deployed artifact/build ancestry/schema and real permitted/denied accounts
GET-only real file download and native-browser smoke, redacted production evidence

safety_hardening.scan_parent: Both existing scan-entries GETs recheck an existing, non-deleted parent of the exact receipt/issue type and its persisted warehouse before using the read cache. Missing warehouse is not GLOBAL. Existing authentication and permission middleware remain mandatory.
safety_hardening.cache_schema: All v2 quantity/completeness fields and group counters must be present, not only quantity_complete. Legacy or incomplete cached summaries reset quantity and completeness flags to null and coverage to LEGACY_CACHE_PENDING_REFRESH, even if an old coverage/flag field already exists. No cache flush, seed or business write is required.
safety_hardening.response_identity: Reserved evidence meta contract/document_id/scan_status/summary/sort/pagination_mode/snapshot_consistent are assigned from this route and sanitized summary; stale response metadata cannot override them. Original data, owner pagination, request metadata and ETag remain unchanged.
safety_hardening.ci_evidence: Both database suites and the route-cache suite must emit non-empty JUnit with assertions and no failures/errors/skips. Required source/report hashes and per-test results go to the log and job summary; no artifact storage quota dependency. P13 regressions remain included; source ancestry retains revision 2 and the P13 fix. Composer lock is not updated.
safety_hardening.fe_handoff: FE must migrate prepared parsers from p12-scan-evidence-v1 to v2 and nullable group quantity/known subtotal, consume meta.p12 and the P09 GET read_target, retain partial errors, owner/privacy and Back/focus/scroll. Do not switch to global fetch, fall back to old fixtures or activate automatically. This backend patch does not modify the FE repository.
safety_hardening.not_approved: All-source aggregation, cross-source state labels and checked/sent ownership remain pending BA. Historical P13 RECORD receipt is not current waiting_for_web or a P12 timeline approval. Deployment/live smoke/full activation remain separate gates.
